en.headline: Customs probe Hotstone Yoga closure as complaints hit 27
en.dek: The Consumer Council said it had taken 27 complaints worth HK$429,326 by 5pm, while Customs posted an investigation notice at the Jordan studio.
body: Customs has opened an investigation into the sudden closure of Hotstone Yoga, after the chain stopped classes at the end of business on Wednesday. A lawyer's notice at the Jordan studio said operations had ended and that written claims should be lodged by 5 October.

The Consumer Council told reporters it had received 27 complaints about a yoga centre's closure by 5pm on Thursday, involving HK$429,326. Customs said it had received reports and would take enforcement action if it found breaches of the Trade Descriptions Ordinance. Officers posted a notice outside the Jordan shop saying the sudden-closure case was under investigation.

The Labour Department said it was concerned and asked affected staff to register at district offices of the Labour Relations Division. The company's notice said September wages and class fees would be paid by 5 October, and that no further classes or packages would be provided.
Customers have said packages were still being sold in the days before the shutdown. Those claims have not been tested in court. The chain had at least five studios.

zh.headline: 海關調查Hotstone Yoga結業 消委會接27宗投訴
zh.dek: 消委會表示截至下午5時接27宗投訴，涉款429,326元；海關在佐敦分店外張貼調查告示。
body: 岩盤瑜伽連鎖店Hotstone Yoga周三營業時間結束後停止課程，海關已就懷疑突然結業展開調查。佐敦分店外張貼律師行通告，指業務已結束，索償須於10月5日前以書面提出。
消費者委員會向傳媒表示，截至周四下午5時，共接27宗有關一間瑜伽中心結業的投訴，涉及金額429,326港元。海關表示已接獲舉報，若發現違反《商品說明條例》，會採取執法行動，並在佐敦分店外張貼告示，指正就懷疑突然結業事件調查。
勞工處表示非常關注，呼籲受影響僱員盡快到勞資關係科各區辦事處登記資料，該處會提供協助。公司通告指，9月工資及堂費將於10月5日或之前發放，停業後不再提供課程或套票。
有學員稱結業前數天仍獲推銷續會。這些說法尚未經法庭裁定。該連鎖店先前至少有五間分店。
